body:
## Summary

The single-flight dispatch design in `src/chat/agent.ts` (`acquireDispatch`, agent.ts:82-90) blocks every subsequent `sendMessage`/`sendSlashRequest`/`sendCompactRequest` until the in-flight request settles. Two paths never settle:

### 1. Worker exit mid-request (agent.ts:206-212) — permanent hang

The exit handler only nulls module state:
```ts
proc.on('exit', (code, signal) => {
  log.warn({ code, signal }, 'bos worker exited');
  if (workerProcess === proc) { workerProcess = null; workerReady = false; }
});
```
The in-flight request's `handleData` stays attached to dead stdout, so `onDone`/`onError` never fire and the panel's `isGenerating` stays true. Worse, `acquireDispatch`'s chain (`prev.then(...)` at agent.ts:86) never resolves, so **all later sends block forever** — `ensureWorker`'s respawn logic can't help because it runs only after `acquireDispatch` (agent.ts:323). Only a manual user cancel (`cancelGeneration` → `releaseDispatch`, agent.ts:472) unsticks it, and the panel's cancel also drops queued messages.

**Repro:** send a long message → `pkill -f dist/bos/worker.js` → spinner stuck, no error shown; type another message → nothing happens.

### 2. `rate-limited` unhandled in sendSlashRequest / sendCompactRequest / sendPaperRequest

The worker emits `rate-limited` from its top-level catch for **any** request type (worker.ts:1976-1978) and from the chat round loop (worker.ts:1756). `sendMessage` handles it (agent.ts:408-418), but the other three senders' switches only handle `token`/`done`/`error` (agent.ts:766-782, 671-688, 872-902) — a `rate-limited` line matches nothing, is silently dropped, and no `cleanup()`/`settle()` runs → the slot is never released. Also `sendCompactRequest`'s `done` requires `msg.compacted === true` (agent.ts:676) — a non-compacted done would hang too.

**Repro:** model returns 429 during `/ariz` or `/patent` → spinner forever; subsequent messages queue and never drain.

## Fix

1. In the worker exit/error handlers, settle the in-flight request: look up `currentCallbacks`/`activeDataHandler`, remove the listener, `releaseDispatch(releaseInFlight)`, and invoke `onError('AI worker exited unexpectedly')`.
2. Add the same `case 'rate-limited'` handling (cleanup + settle + surface to panel) to `sendSlashRequest`, `sendCompactRequest`, and `sendPaperRequest`, mirroring `sendMessage`.
title: Chat pipeline permanently hangs when the worker exits mid-request or returns rate-limited: dispatch slot never released
